definitions.explanation: Material wealth, money, or valuable possessions. Can also refer to abundance or richness in a broader sense.

examples.japanese: {富|とみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分配|ぶんぱい}→分配：11746_bunpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不公平|ふこうへい}→不公平：16851_fukouhei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The distribution of wealth is being criticized as unfair.

examples.english: I realized as I got older that health is the greatest wealth of all.

notes:
{富|とみ} is a noun meaning wealth or riches. It can refer to both material wealth and abstract richness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {富|とみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ (to build wealth)
- {富|とみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to gain wealth)
- {富|とみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分配|ぶんぱい}→分配：11746_bunpai⟧ (distribution of wealth)
- {富|とみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧ (wealth and power)
- {富|とみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧ (symbol of wealth)

- ⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (to be rich, to abound — the verb form)
